tasks.goal: Inspect Plaesy CLI and compare documented Hindsight capabilities, then propose and implement one high-impact, bounded feature that fits Plaesy constraints. Before editing inspect git status, repo guidance, relevant files and existing tests. Preserve all existing changes and do not modify Hermes plugin, do not make paid provider calls. Feature should be selected from concrete gap, include tests/docs, and be fully verified. Avoid claiming feature superiority globally.

Independent research/audit: inspect current Plaesy CLI features and Hindsight public docs, identify one concrete feature gap with a narrowly-scoped, offline-compatible implementation opportunity. Do not edit files. Cite local paths and upstream URLs/features. Check worktree status, avoid assumptions.
